area_definition: OpenDB standard-cell area in um2, excluding CORE_SPACER, including taps; functional/sequential/physical-only areas separate
timing_definition: report_worst_slack max/min and report_tns max/min under common SDC; coverage checked with check_setup; minimum_clock_period is not a combinational data-path delay
feasibility: grt: complete timing coverage and nonnegative TT setup slack; hold separately reported; final: coverage plus nonnegative TT setup/hold, SPEF and zero routing DRC; no multi-corner signoff claim

detailed_route_scope.additional_selection: from remaining completed main-table records, take closest-to-zero setup/hold slack per family, then smallest nonzero C/D area gap among pairs feasible at the main stage; stable case_id/group tie break; include failures without replacing them by favorable points
detailed_route_scope.purpose: separate physical recheck table; never replace individual main-table metrics or reselect B/C from physical results

resources.memory_enforcement: all descendants across sessions, with inherited ancestry token and PID/starttime identity; RSS sampled every 0.5s; TERM then KILL even after leader exit; remaining-live-PID check
resources.scope: all calibration, prototypes, search, final evaluation, physical recheck, repeats and retries share these global caps

initial_search_limits.cache_policy: record all actual calls and hits; final evaluation can reuse an identical already-measured stage with attribution; no unrecorded feedback in B/C

repeat_and_retry.repeat_policy: repeat critical and small-gain representative points before interpreting feasibility or gains; changed feasibility/ranking must be reported as unstable; no assumed fixed ps noise floor
repeat_and_retry.failure_retention: keep stage, command, exit code, timeout/memory flags and raw logs; unavailable stage metrics stay absent

resource_estimate_basis: two full 32x32 multiplier runs and one end-to-end entrypoint run at 1500 ps; larger div/fp designs must be measured before freezing main-matrix numerical limits
scope_of_enforcement: current runner enforces per-invocation timeouts, process-group RSS cap and fresh output directories; cumulative search/matrix counters will be implemented with step7 driver
revision_reason: process-tree cleanup, target-conditioned model identity, TT setup-only grt classification and portable evidence

timing_scope.hold_review_margin_role: engineering recheck trigger; not measured noise floor or worst-corner guarantee
timing_scope.comparison_rule: grt ranking uses setup feasibility and area; hold below review margin marks recheck_required, not infeasible solely from grt hold

evidence_policy.required_local_validation: source/summary hashes checked without build or external tool installations
evidence_policy.optional_large_artifacts: logs/ODB/SPEF in build; historical paths are provenance, not required local dependencies
